prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1056; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented after a low-speed head-on collision with pain and swelling over the left distal radius. Imaging was consistent with a wrist fracture, and the reported mechanism of injury is medically compatible with the findings. The patient attended three visits. Treatment was somewhat longer than typical for this type of fracture, with immobilization followed by graded range-of-motion work as healing progressed. On examination, localized tenderness and reduced grip strength were documented and support the diagnosis, while neurovascular checks, sensation, and capillary refill remained normal. The patient mentioned a minor wrist strain several years ago that resolved completely without lasting limitation, and there is no evidence of ongoing impairment from that episode. Billing records reflect single charges for each service with no duplicated or repeated entries. Current plan includes a follow-up assessment to confirm alignment and functional recovery.
